author: JayzTwoCents
description: I have been watercooling for over 30 years and I always wanted to try and make my own CPU block... well, I finally did it! How did it turn out? Be subscribed to check out the long form video where I take you through my journey of teaching myself Fusion 360 and CNC Milling at the same time!
title: I FINALLY made my OWN CPU block! #pcmr #watercooling #pcgaming
